text:
Rina: Quick flag — GreenEdge renewal PO just landed but it's for a 6-month term while our signed quote is 12 months. PO# GE-2026-78 also says 'QES required' for signature. Our e-sign flow doesn't support QES. Jamal, did procurement change anything on their side? :eyes:
Jamal: I saw the PO. Procurement inserted quarterly billing and the QES requirement after contract review. I had sent the 12mo SOW yesterday. Procurement says their policy requires QES for contracts >€50k.
Nadia: Finance note: we can't process QES natively. We'll need either a scanned signed PDF + confirmation email from their procurement, or Legal to approve accepting QES via a vendor. Also need VAT ID and GL mapping before invoicing. Opening FIN-4890.
DocuSignBot: Send attempt failed: "Signature type not supported: QES". Recommend alternative signing method.
Lars: Legal here. Two practical options: 1) request GreenEdge upload a scanned wet-signed contract (we accept for renewals) and attach a procurement confirmation email that locks the 12-month term; 2) onboard QES provider which is 2-3 weeks. Recommend option 1 to avoid delay. I'll draft a short addendum stating acceptance of scanned signature for PO GE-2026-78.
Rina: If we do wet-sign it'll add ~3 business days. Onboarding currently at 85% and they expect feature flip in 2 business days. Enablement — can you hold the release if needed?
Enablement: We can hold the rollout for up to 5 business days with minimal customer impact. We'll prep a short comms template for CSM to set expectations.
Jamal: I'll reach back to procurement and ask them to either remove QES requirement or confirm they will upload a scanned signed PDF to their portal and cc procurement@greenedge.com. I'll push for the upload by COB tomorrow.
Nadia: Also request they include VAT ID and GL code on the PO. Without VAT ID finance can't finalize tax handling.
Lars: Draft addendum uploaded: /docs/amendments/GE_78_wet_sign_addendum_v1.docx. Key line: "For the avoidance of doubt, the Parties agree that a scanned wet signature attached to PO GE-2026-78 constitutes an executed instrument for purposes of this renewal and confirms a 12-month term at the agreed rate." Will circulate for exec sign once procurement confirms.
Rina: Noted. Action items: Jamal to confirm upload, Nadia to wait on VAT/GL, Lars to queue exec signature, Enablement on standby to hold.
Jamal: Just heard back — procurement says their portal will accept a PDF upload and they can attach the PO scan by tomorrow morning. They've agreed to remove the QES flag for this order but will keep it as a policy note. I cc'd procurement@greenedge.com.
FinanceBot: FIN-4890 updated: awaiting PO scan + VAT ID + GL code from customer.
Nadia: If the scan arrives with VAT ID + GL code we can process the quarterly invoices. If they want quarterly billing that deviates from our standard, we need it documented in the addendum — please confirm in writing.
Rina: I'll mark onboarding as "hold" and send the enablement comms to the CSM now. If final docs arrive and finance confirms by EOD tomorrow we can proceed with release on Monday.
Lars: Once the scan is uploaded I'll sign the addendum and route to Exec for countersign if required.
Jamal: Upload done — procurement uploaded scan and included VAT ID. Forwarded to this thread. Please confirm legal/finance review.
Nadia: Reviewed the scan: VAT ID present, GL code missing. Jamal — can you ask procurement to add GL code in their portal note or email? We can't finalize invoicing without it.
Rina: Pinged procurement for GL code. Also updated CSM to expect a one-day delay.
Lars: Signed amendment and routed for exec countersign.
FinanceBot: FIN-4890 updated: waiting on exec countersign; GL code still pending.
Jamal: Procurement replied — they'll send an email with GL code to finance@redwood.com and cc procurement@greenedge.com within the hour.
Nadia: Got the GL code email. Finance can proceed once countersign complete.
Rina: Closing loop: exec countersigned addendum, finance confirmed, onboarding hold lifted. Release scheduled for Monday. Thanks team :tada:
